notes.title: The New Rome: Laying the Foundations
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to the first dev diary for [i]The New Rome[/i]! 

We’re creating a unique experience where you’ll help shape a thriving Roman city by constructing timeless monuments.

As you know, Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither is The New Rome! Right now, we’re hard at work implementing the construction system. 

Since you’ll play as an architect, the construction feature is at the heart of the game. Our goal is to give you as much freedom as possible to customize your building projects according to your aesthetic and strategic choices.

Things are coming along well, and we can’t wait to show you more soon! In the meantime, here’s a sneak peek at an early altar project - one of the first steps in bringing the city to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057624/d774087376ead57c8b2016229cf46971e30309f7.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates and the appearance of new building projects!
